check-then-build — the eager walk re-cloned every fully-concrete site
type at every reference read; the change-walk uses raw-recursion loops

mentl/dd1e6ca:
Host perf (the only profiler that survives the compiler's proc_exit; three
--profile=guest attempts wrote empty) pinned list_index at 98% of a sample, 74%
under classify_grade_all. The resume-cardinality classifier's dataflow fixpoint
was O(rounds * (N^2 + calls*N)): usage_summary_lookup was an O(N) by-name linear
scan per call-node per round, and decls/entries were cons-lists re-indexed
O(N^2), all times the fixpoint rounds.

The grade is a per-fn fact keyed by name — read it O(1), never re-scan (the same
str_hash index the env resolution uses). summary_of resolves through
build_summary_index/summary_index_get; decls and the round entries are flattened
so their list_index is O(1). Reverse insertion preserves first-match order, so
grades are identical when nested fns shadow a name. usage_summary_lookup stays
for the COLD readers (resume_summaries_ctx, read once per handler arm;
lower.mn:1012, once per fn) — deleting it outright broke the first build until
tracing its callers.

Measured: m3-gen 1400s -> 749s (~2x), m2 == m3 byte-identical (467908 lines),
66/66 micros, 5/5 crown-gate. The perf 98% was of the sample (the classifier
phase) — the classifier was ~47% of the whole; the remaining 749s is next.

Docs: the code-reading diagnosis (PLAN 5.O) MISSED this entirely — a static read
cannot see a fixpoint's rounds x per-call rescans compounding, and the env O(n^2)
it named biggest was 0.5-4% (below noise). 5.O gains the correction, 8 documents

mentl/ddb97bb:
Substrate gap surfaced at b139622 commit-attempt: the determinism gate
ran wasmtime to completion before checking exit code. With today's
seed single-threaded through wheel infer-perm-pressure (40+ min per
pass × 2 runs), every src/lib commit paid ~80 min hook tax. Killing
the wasmtime caused exit-non-zero which the gate already interprets
as the pre-bootstrap escape; the fix promotes that escape to
fail-fast on a bounded wall-clock cap.

Per ULTIMATE_MEDIUM §4.6 (the medium IS its own build system), the
determinism-gate is a build-system handler; making it bounded is
making the build-system handler discipline-honest. Continuing
substrate work without fixing the gate is drift mode 9 — silently
accepting friction we know how to remove.

Fix: wrap each `wasmtime run` invocation in `timeout ${DET_TIMEOUT_S}s`.
Default 60s; override via env var for known-bounded subsets. Both
runs timeout-bounded symmetrically. Timeout exit (124) takes the
existing pre-bootstrap escape path uniformly with non-zero exit.

Verified end-to-end:
- src/main.nx alone (1 file): 0.04 sec, byte-identical pass
- Full wheel cat src+lib: 60.02 sec bail with pre-bootstrap message
  (was 50+ min hang previously)

Once the seed catches up at Tier 3 post-L1 and parallel_compose
intercepts BOTH parallel verbs (commits cb2b1a0 + b139622), the
wheel-through-seed runtime should fan out across cores and return
within the 60s cap. The cap then becomes load-bearing; today it's
the escape clause.

sonido/dd454ac:
The README promised VST3 "via clap-wrapper (external build step)" but
no build step existed anywhere. scripts/bundle-vst3.sh makes it real: it
pins free-audio/clap-wrapper v0.15.1, builds the dynamic CLAP-as-VST3
wrapper once, and stamps out one renamed .vst3 per .clap in dist-clap,
since the wrapper resolves its CLAP from its own runtime filename stem.
Names derive from the .clap files, so there is no second plugin list to
drift. Wrapped sonido-delay and sonido-eq pass all 47 Steinberg VST3
validator tests on Linux.

The wrapper searches the standard CLAP install locations only:
clap-wrapper 0.15.1 ignores $CLAP_PATH on POSIX (inverted empty-check
in getValidCLAPSearchPaths), which the script header documents.

two-top/dd9b282:
The chasm was cut as a vertical band when the duel ran along the x-axis
with spawns at (+/-100, 0). The depth-duel change moved the spawns to
(0, +/-300) and nobody rotated the moat, which put both spawn points
inside it: stand still at round start on Crossing and the chasm devours
you, and tick_respawn snaps every killed player straight back into the
band while SpawnGuard deliberately leaves chasm kills lethal - so the
first kill cascades kills for the rest of the round. Every existing
chasm test hand-placed players at safe coordinates, which is how the
bug lived through 500+ green tests; the new regression test stands both
players on respawn_position() itself and failed before this change.

The moat now runs horizontally between the two seats - the original
design intent under the current axes - and the altar sigils move off
the duel axis onto each seat's half at (+/-230, +/-150), point-symmetric
and clear of the pillars, because on the y-axis every straight throw at
the opponent would have clipped one by accident.

perennials/dd0760b:
The third projection stops being a geometry viewer wearing the
drawing's palette and joins the drawing. Archetype bodies switch from
Lambert to a stepped toon ramp — silkscreen, not moulded plastic — and
every figure takes the ink line the elevation always stroked around it,
as a back-face shell that needs no post-processing and doubles as the
selection state (sepia when the measurement is hers, full ink when
picked). The sheet texture gains the same tooth as the SVG sheets
(seeded speckle, lib/paper.ts), a hairline border, the beds' pooled
edges, and sits on a sunk mat so the card has an edge from low angles;
paper-coloured fog dissolves the far corner into the page.

The light behaves like a day: below 28 degrees the sun warms and the
sky cools, both computed from her numbers exactly as the shadows are;
below the horizon the page itself dims to a real dusk instead of a
broken-looking flat grey. Dark paper gets a 1.2x sun so lit and shaded
ground still separate. The scene bakes CSS colours at build, so a
MutationObserver on data-theme plus a prefers-color-scheme listener now
poke a rebuild — the model follows the theme live instead of holding
yesterday's ink.

Her photos become mounted prints: a raised-paper border behind each,
and the stand turns to face the eye every render, so walking around a
photo no longer turns it edge-on and invisible. The same dressing pass
fades far name sprites by distance relative to where she is looking and
holds near ones to a caption's share of the screen — the walk-in view
was a label cloud with a garden somewhere behind it.

noodles/ddbf56c:
Sound-neutral performance for the weak-phone case: lookAhead goes 0.1
-> 0.25 s. Scheduling runs on the main thread, and on little cores one
janky frame under 0.1 s of headroom becomes an audible gap; more
headroom costs nothing audible since interactive previews still fire
at now and the heard-time visual clock reads currentTime directly. A
custom 44.1 kHz context (the ~8% DSP saving on 48 k devices) was tried
and reverted: wrapping a custom-rate native AudioContext in
Tone.Context throws stackless InvalidStateErrors, and the win isn't
worth shipping against that edge. The one-shots resample once at
decode and cache, so playback cost is unchanged either way.

Builder mix notes: reverb sends default drier (harmony -18, melody
-20, drums -24; bass stays off), and the reverb input gets a 200 Hz
highpass so kicks and 808 subs never reach the tail — reverberant low
end reads as mud, not space. Post-change sweep: eight dice rolls
within 1.1 dB on the master.
